services.title: Roof Replacement
services.short_description: Full tear-off and replacement backed by a lifetime manufacturer warranty and a 10-year workmanship warranty.
services.long_description: Even a well-maintained roof eventually reaches the end of its life. A 3-tab asphalt shingle roof lasts 15-20 years, architectural shingles 20-25, and tile or metal 50 or better. When age, storm damage, or a bad original installation takes out too much of the surface to justify a repair, we replace the whole system. Every crew on your roof is a Royal Roofing crew — we never subcontract. We handle tear-off through final cleanup, and if the replacement is going through insurance we attend the adjuster appointment to make sure they see the same damage we documented.

services.title: Roof Repair
services.short_description: Same-day free inspection and estimate, with 24/7 emergency response for active leaks.
services.long_description: Wet spots on the ceiling and shingles in the yard are the two calls we get most. The earlier we find the problem, the less likely it is to spread into the deck and structure — and the more likely a repair is enough. Our certified contractors inspect the roof and generate an estimate the same day, and we can file and manage the insurance claim so all you pay is the deductible. We repair steep-pitch asphalt shingle, flat TPO, slate, and metal systems. Residential repair service is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

services.title: Storm Damage Repair
services.short_description: Local storm-damage specialists who work your insurance claim start to finish — no storm chasers.
services.long_description: Timing matters after severe weather, but so does who you call. Storm chasers overcharge and leave behind temporary fixes that need attention again in a season. We're here year-round. We start with a free inspection and an estimate broken out line by line, then work hand in hand with your adjuster — we know the software and resources insurance companies use, and catering to their system is what makes the process simple for you. Water that gets into the attic ruins underlayment and decking long before you notice it inside, which is why the free inspection comes first.

services.title: Siding & Gutters
services.short_description: Vinyl, wood, metal and fiber cement siding plus seamless aluminum gutters — with 0% financing available.
services.long_description: Siding does more than set the look of a house. Quality siding holds heat in through a Pennsylvania winter, keeps the place cooler in July, and stands up to rain, wind and snow while keeping bugs and dirt out. We install vinyl, wood, metal and fiber cement, each fitted with the same care we give a roof. Gutters are the other half of that envelope — they protect windows, siding and foundation, and seamless aluminum runs eliminate the joints where sectional gutters leak and clog. We evaluate size, roof pitch and surrounding trees before recommending a system, and we repair and replace existing gutters too.

services.title: Custom Decks
services.short_description: TREX composite, cedar and pressure-treated decks built to fit how you actually use the yard.
services.long_description: A good deck doesn't come out of a box. Maybe you need a spot for the grill and a table, maybe you want something bigger where family can spread out all summer. We walk the options with you: TREX composite with vinyl railings if you want low maintenance that doesn't fade or need sealing every year, cedar if you want the natural look and a surface you can walk barefoot on, pressure-treated if you want tough and practical without a big price tag. We also fix what a bad winter left behind — boards pulling up, railings that wobble, stairs that aren't safe. Ask about pergolas, gazebos and vinyl railings, and about 0% financing.
